title: 8 Years Later, Fan-Favorite Crunchyroll Anime Reveals Disappointing Update on Return
content: Eight years after it came to an end, one fan-favorite anime now streaming with Crunchyroll has unfortunately gotten a disappointing update about a possible return for a new season.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s New Live-Action Anime Adaptation Shares First Look
content: One Piece, Avatar: The Last Airbender, and Yu Yu Hakusho have been big boons for Netflix when it comes to turning the tables on how anime fans felt about live-action anime adaptations.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Creator Returns With New Shonen Jump Crossover After Finale
content: Jujutsu Kaisen might have ended both its original series and sequel release , but the creator behind it all has returned to highlight another major standout of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Yomi no Tsugai' Announces Supporting Cast
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Yomi no Tsugai ( Daemons of the Shadow Realm ) television anime revealed supporting cast on Saturday. The anime series adapting Hiromu Arakawa 's action fantasy manga began airing on Tokyo MX, BS11, and other stations at 11:30 p.m. on April 4.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 4 Years Later, Netflix’s Best Zombie Horror is Still a Brutal Masterclass (& It Can’t Return Quick Enough)
content: While Netflix has plenty of iconic horror shows in the streaming service’s back catalogue, one zombie thriller remains the most brutal masterclass in the genre’s small-screen history.
author: ComicBook

title: Pragmata Game Crosses 2 Million Units Sold Worldwide
content: The game sold over 1 million units worldwide in its first two days. The science-fiction action-adventure game launched for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on April 17, one week earlier than the planned April 24 date. The game also has a demo available for all four platforms.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Breakout Anime Creator Breaks Silence on Live-Action Movie Success
content: One of Netflix ‘s biggest anime hits has made its official live-action movie debut in Japan, and the creator behind it all is celebrating its success with a special new release for fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Anime Casts Shinichirō Miki
content: The staff for the television anime of Hiromu Arakawa 's Daemons of the Shadow Realm ( Yomi no Tsugai ) manga confirmed on Sunday that Shinichirō Miki is playing Ivan Yosano, a mysterious daemon user who appeared in episode 6 on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Akane-banashi Anime's New Video Previews Karaku Cup Arc
content: The staff for the anime of writer Yūki Suenaga and illustrator Takamasa Moue 's Akane-banashi manga posted a new promotional video and key visual on Sunday. The video teases the Karaku Cup arc about the student rakugo storytelling tournament of the same name.
author: ANN

title: Bungo Stray Dogs Releases Official Statement Following Hilarious Controversy
content: Bungo Stray Dogs might not have the same popularity as other anime adaptations from Studio BONES, such as My Hero Academia and Fullmetal Alchemist , but the anime adaptation has found its fanbase.
